# DELETE VARIABLES

Remove variables from the dataset.

## Syntax

```text
DELETE VARIABLES varlist.
```

## Example

```text
DELETE VARIABLES tmp1 tmp2 q7_1 TO q7_9.
```

`statscraft help DELETE VARIABLES` prints the same text in the terminal. [All commands](README.md)
